meta.title: Download VireMusic
meta.description: The VireMusic desktop app for Windows — the same player, a system tray, and OS media keys. macOS, Linux, and mobile clients are in development.

hero.title: VireMusic on your computer
hero.subtitle: A native window, system tray, Play/Pause/Next/Previous media keys, and a "Now Playing" widget — the same music as in your browser.

windows.title: Windows
windows.text: An .exe installer, x64. Requires Windows 10 or later.

macos.title: macOS
macos.text: A Mac build is in development.

linux.title: Linux
linux.text: A Linux build is in development.

ios.title: iOS
ios.text: A mobile app is on the backlog, not the top priority right now.

android.title: Android
android.text: A mobile app is on the backlog, not the top priority right now.

pwa.title: Available today — a web app
pwa.text: While there's no native client for your platform yet, you can install VireMusic as a PWA right from your browser: its own icon, a separate window, and offline track downloads.

banner.text: Get VireMusic for Windows — a native app with a system tray and media keys
